1.text: Paul, called 2 be an apostle of Jesus Christ through tha will of God, N Sosthenes our brother,
2 tha church of God which is at Corinth, 2 ’em dat r sanctified in Christ Jesus, called 2 be saints, wit all dat in every place call upon tha name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs N ours:
Grace be 2 u, N peace, from God our Father, N from tha Lord Jesus Christ.
I thank my God always on ur behalf, 4 tha grace of God which is given u by Jesus Christ;
Dat in every thing y’all r enriched by him, in all utterance, N in all knowledge;
Even as tha testimony of Christ was confirmed in u:
So dat y’all come behind in no gift; waitin 4 tha comin of our Lord Jesus Christ:
Who shall also confirm u 2 tha end, dat y’all may be blameless in tha day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
God is faithful, by whom y’all were called 2 tha fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

Now I beg u, brothers, by tha name of our Lord Jesus Christ, dat y’all all speak tha same thing, N dat there be no divisions among u; but dat y’all be perfectly joined together in tha same mind N in tha same judgment.
4 it has been declared 2 me of u, my brothers, by ’em which r of tha house of Chloe, dat there r contentions among u.
Now dis I say, dat every one of u says, I am of Paul; N I of Apollos; N I of Cephas; N I of Christ.
Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified 4 u? or were y’all baptized in tha name of Paul?
I thank God dat I baptized none of u, but Crispus N Gaius;
Lest any should say dat I had baptized in my own name.
N I baptized also tha household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
4 Christ sent me not 2 baptize, but 2 preach tha gospel: not wit wisdom of words, lest tha cross of Christ should be made of none effect.
4 tha preachin of tha cross is 2 ’em dat perish foolishness; but 2 us which r saved it is tha power of God.
4 it is written, I will destroy tha wisdom of tha wise, N will bring 2 nothing tha understanding of tha prudent.
Where is tha wise? where is tha scribe? where is tha disputer of dis world? has not God made foolish tha wisdom of dis world?
4 after dat in tha wisdom of God tha world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by tha foolishness of preachin 2 save ’em dat believe.
4 tha Jews require a sign, N tha Greeks seek after wisdom:
But we preach Christ crucified, 2 tha Jews a stumblingblock, N 2 tha Greeks foolishness;
But 2 ’em which r called, both Jews N Greeks, Christ tha power of God, N tha wisdom of God.
Because tha foolishness of God is wiser than men; N tha weakness of God is stronger than men.
4 y’all see ur callin, brothers, how dat not many wise men after tha flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, r called:
But God has chosen tha foolish things of tha world 2 confound tha wise; N God has chosen tha weak things of tha world 2 confound tha things which r mighty;
N base things of tha world, N things which r despised, has God chosen, yeah, N things which r not, 2 bring 2 nothing things dat r:
Dat no flesh should glory in his presence.
But of him r y’all in Christ Jesus, who of God is made 2 us wisdom, N righteousness, N sanctification, N redemption:
Dat, according as it is written, He dat glorieth, let him glory in tha Lord.

2.text: N I, brothers, when I came 2 u, came not wit excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring 2 u tha testimony of God.
4 I determined not 2 know any thing among u, save Jesus Christ, N him crucified.
N I was wit u in weakness, N in fear, N in much tremblin.
N my speech N my preachin was not wit enticing words of man’s wisdom, but in demonstration of tha Spirit N of power:
Dat ur faith should not stand in tha wisdom of men, but in tha power of God.
But we speak wisdom among ’em dat r perfect: yet not tha wisdom of dis world, nor of tha princes of dis world, dat come 2 nothing:
But we speak tha wisdom of God in a mystery, even tha hidden wisdom, which God ordained before tha world 2 our glory:
Which none of tha princes of dis world knew: 4 had dey known it, dey would not have crucified tha Lord of glory.
But as it is written, Eye has not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered in2 tha heart of man, tha things which God has prepared 4 ’em dat love him.
But God has revealed ’em 2 us by his Spirit: 4 tha Spirit searches all things, yeah, tha deep things of God.
4 what man knows tha things of a man, save tha spirit of man which is in him? even so tha things of God knows no man, but tha Spirit of God.
Now we have received, not tha spirit of tha world, but tha spirit which is of God; dat we might know tha things dat r freely given 2 us of God.
Which things also we speak, not in tha words which man’s wisdom teaches, but which tha Holy Ghost teaches; comparing spiritual things wit spiritual.
But tha natural man receives not tha things of tha Spirit of God: 4 dey r foolishness 2 him: neither can he know ’em, because dey r spiritually discerned.
But he dat is spiritual judges all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.
4 who has known tha mind of tha Lord, dat he may instruct him? But we have tha mind of Christ.

3.text: N I, brothers, could not speak 2 u as 2 spiritual, but as 2 carnal, even as 2 babes in Christ.
I have fed u wit milk, N not wit food: 4 until now y’all were not able 2 bear it, neither yet now r y’all able.
4 y’all r yet carnal: 4 whereas there is among u envying, N strife, N divisions, r y’all not carnal, N walk as men?
4 while one says, I am of Paul; N another, I am of Apollos; r y’all not carnal?
Who then is Paul, N who is Apollos, but ministers by whom y’all believed, even as tha Lord gave 2 every man?
I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave tha increase.
So then neither is he dat planteth any thing, neither he dat watereth; but God dat gives tha increase.
Now he dat planteth N he dat watereth r one: N every man shall receive his own reward according 2 his own labour.
4 we r labourers together wit God: y’all r God’s husbandry, y’all r God’s buildin.
According 2 tha grace of God which is given 2 me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid tha foundation, N another builds thereon. But let every man pay attention how he builds thereupon.
4 other foundation can no man lay than dat is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
Now if any man build upon dis foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;
Every man’s work shall be made manifest: 4 tha day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; N tha fire shall try every man’s work of what sort it is.
If any man’s work abide which he has built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.
If any man’s work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
Know y’all not dat y’all r tha temple of God, N dat tha Spirit of God lives in u?
If any man defile tha temple of God, him shall God destroy; 4 tha temple of God is holy, which temple y’all r.
Let no man deceive himself. If any man among u seems 2 be wise in dis world, let him become a fool, dat he may be wise.
4 tha wisdom of dis world is foolishness wit God. 4 it is written, He takes tha wise in their own craftiness.
N again, tha Lord knows tha thoughts of tha wise, dat dey r vain.
Therefore let no man glory in men. 4 all things r urz;
Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or tha world, or life, or death, or things present, or things 2 come; all r urz;
N y’all r Christ’s; N Christ is God’s.

4.text: Let a man so account of us, as of tha ministers of Christ, N stewards of tha mysteries of God.
Moreover it is required in stewards, dat a man be found faithful.
But wit me it is a very small thing dat I should be judged of u, or of man’s judgment: yeah, I judge not my own self.
4 I know nothing by myself; yet am I not by dis justified: but he dat judges me is tha Lord.

Therefore judge nothing before tha time, until tha Lord come, who both will bring 2 light tha hidden things of darkness, N will make manifest tha counsels of tha hearts: N then shall every man have praise of God.

N dese things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred 2 myself N 2 Apollos 4 ur sakes; dat y’all might learn in us not 2 think of men above dat which is written, dat no one of u be puffed up 4 one against another.
4 who makes u 2 differ from another? N what have u dat u did not receive? now if u did receive it, why do u glory, as if u had not received it?
Now y’all r full, now y’all r rich, y’all have reigned as kings without us: N I would 2 God y’all did reign, dat we also might reign wit u.
4 I think dat God has set forth us tha apostles last, as it were appointed 2 death: 4 we r made a spectacle 2 tha world, N 2 angels, N 2 men.
We r fools 4 Christ’s sake, but y’all r wise in Christ; we r weak, but y’all r strong; y’all r honourable, but we r despised.
Even 2 dis present hour we both hunger, N thirst, N r naked, N r buffeted, N have no certain dwellingplace;
N labour, workin wit our own hands: bein reviled, we bless; bein persecuted, we suffer it:
Bein defamed, we intreat: we r made as tha filth of tha world, N r tha offscouring of all things 2 dis day.
I write not dese things 2 shame u, but as my beloved sons I warn u.
4 though y’all have ten thousand instructers in Christ, yet have y’all not many fathers: 4 in Christ Jesus I have begotten u through tha gospel.
So I beg u, be y’all followers of me.
4 dis cause have I sent 2 u Timotheus, who is my beloved son, N faithful in tha Lord, who shall bring u in2 remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.
Now some r puffed up, as though I would not come 2 u.
But I will come 2 u shortly, if tha Lord will, N will know, not tha speech of ’em which r puffed up, but tha power.
4 tha kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.
What will y’all? shall I come 2 u wit a rod, or in love, N in tha spirit of meekness?

5.text: It is reported commonly dat there is fornication among u, N such fornication as is not so much as named among tha Gentiles, dat one should have his father’s wife.
N y’all r puffed up, N have not rather mourned, dat he dat has done dis deed might be taken away from among u.
4 I for real, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him dat has so done dis deed,
In tha name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when y’all r gathered together, N my spirit, wit tha power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
2 deliver such an one 2 Satan 4 tha destruction of tha flesh, dat tha spirit may be saved in tha day of tha Lord Jesus.
Ur glorying is not good. Know y’all not dat a little leaven leaveneth tha whole lump?
Purge out therefore tha old leaven, dat y’all may be a new lump, as y’all r unleavened. 4 even Christ our passover is sacrificed 4 us:
Therefore let us keep tha feast, not wit old leaven, neither wit tha leaven of malice N wickedness; but wit tha unleavened bread of sincerity N truth.
I wrote 2 u in an epistle not 2 company wit fornicators:
Yet not altogether wit tha fornicators of dis world, or wit tha covetous, or extortioners, or wit idolaters; 4 then must y’all needs go out of tha world.

But now I have written 2 u not 2 keep company, if any man dat is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; wit such an one no not 2 eat.
4 what have I 2 do 2 judge ’em also dat r without? do not y’all judge ’em dat r within?
But ’em dat r without God judges. Therefore put away from among y’all dat wicked person.

6.text: Dare any of u, havin a matter against another, go 2 law before tha unjust, N not before tha saints?
Do y’all not know dat tha saints shall judge tha world? N if tha world shall be judged by u, r y’all unworthy 2 judge tha smallest matters?
Know y’all not dat we shall judge angels? how much more things dat pertain 2 dis life?
If then y’all have judgments of things pertaining 2 dis life, set ’em 2 judge who r least esteemed in tha church.
I speak 2 ur shame. Is it so, dat there is not a wise man among u? no, not one dat shall be able 2 judge between his brothers?
But brother goes 2 law wit brother, N dat before tha unbelievers.
Now therefore there is utterly a fault among u, because y’all go 2 law one wit another. Why do y’all not rather take wrong? why do y’all not rather suffer y’all 2 be defrauded?
No, y’all do wrong, N defraud, N dat ur brothers.
Know y’all not dat tha unrighteous shall not inherit tha kingdom of God? don’t be deceived: neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor effeminate, nor abusers of themselves wit mankind,
Nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor extortioners, shall inherit tha kingdom of God.
N such were some of u: but y’all r washed, but y’all r sanctified, but y’all r justified in tha name of tha Lord Jesus, N by tha Spirit of our God.
All things r lawful 2 me, but all things r not expedient: all things r lawful 4 me, but I will not be brought under tha power of any.
Meats 4 tha belly, N tha belly 4 meats: but God shall destroy both it N ’em. Now tha body is not 4 fornication, but 4 tha Lord; N tha Lord 4 tha body.
N God has both raised up tha Lord, N will also raise up us by his own power.
Know y’all not dat ur bodies r tha members of Christ? shall I then take tha members of Christ, N make ’em tha members of an harlot? God forbid.
What? know y’all not dat he which is joined 2 an harlot is one body? 4 two, says he, shall be one flesh.
But he dat is joined 2 tha Lord is one spirit.
Flee fornication. Every sin dat a man does is without tha body; but he dat commits fornication sins against his own body.
What? know y’all not dat ur body is tha temple of tha Holy Ghost which is in u, which y’all have of God, N y’all r not ur own?
4 y’all r bought wit a price: therefore glorify God in ur body, N in ur spirit, which r God’s.

7.text: Now concerning tha things whereof y’all wrote 2 me: It is good 4 a man not 2 touch a woman.
Nevertheless, 2 avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, N let every woman have her own husband.
Let tha husband render 2 tha wife due benevolence: N likewise also tha wife 2 tha husband.
Tha wife has not power of her own body, but tha husband: N likewise also tha husband has not power of his own body, but tha wife.
Defraud y’all not one tha other, except it be wit consent 4 a time, dat y’all may give y’all 2 fasting N prayer; N come together again, dat Satan tempt u not 4 ur incontinency.
But I speak dis by permission, N not of commandment.
4 I would dat all men were even as I myself. But every man has his proper gift of God, one after dis manner, N another after dat.
I say therefore 2 tha unmarried N widows, It is good 4 ’em if dey abide even as I.
But if dey cannot contain, let ’em marry: 4 it is better 2 marry than 2 burn.
N 2 tha married I command, yet not I, but tha Lord, don’t let tha wife depart from her husband:
But N if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled 2 her husband: N don’t let tha husband put away his wife.
But 2 tha rest speak I, not tha Lord: If any brother has a wife dat believes not, N she be pleased 2 live wit him, let him not put her away.
N tha woman which has an husband dat believes not, N if he be pleased 2 live wit her, let her not leave him.
4 tha unbelieving husband is sanctified by tha wife, N tha unbelieving wife is sanctified by tha husband: else were ur children unclean; but now r dey holy.
But if tha unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases: but God has called us 2 peace.
4 what know u, O wife, whether u will save ur husband? or how know u, O man, whether u will save ur wife?
But as God has distributed 2 every man, as tha Lord has called every one, so let him walk. N so ordain I in all churches.
Is any man called bein circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Is any called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.
Circumcision is nothing, N uncircumcision is nothing, but tha keepin of tha commandments of God.
Let every man abide in tha same callin in which he was called.
R u called bein a servant? care not 4 it: but if u may be made free, use it rather.
4 he dat is called in tha Lord, bein a servant, is tha Lord’s freeman: likewise also he dat is called, bein free, is Christ’s servant.
y’all r bought wit a price; don’t be y’all tha servants of men.
Brothers, let every man, in which he is called, in it abide wit God.
Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of tha Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one dat has obtained mercy of tha Lord 2 be faithful.
I suppose therefore dat dis is good 4 tha present distress, I say, dat it is good 4 a man so 2 be.
R u bound 2 a wife? seek not 2 be loosed. r u loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.
But N if u marry, u have not sinned; N if a virgin marry, she has not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in tha flesh: but I spare u.
But dis I say, brothers, tha time is short: it remains, dat both dey dat have wives be as though dey had none;
N dey dat weep, as though dey wept not; N dey dat rejoice, as though dey rejoiced not; N dey dat buy, as though dey possessed not;
N dey dat use dis world, as not abusing it: 4 tha fashion of dis world passes away.
But I would have u without carefulness. He dat is unmarried cares 4 tha things dat belong 2 tha Lord, how he may please tha Lord:
But he dat is married cares 4 tha things dat r of tha world, how he may please his wife.

There is difference also between a wife N a virgin. tha unmarried woman cares 4 tha things of tha Lord, dat she may be holy both in body N in spirit: but she dat is married cares 4 tha things of tha world, how she may please her husband.
N dis I speak 4 ur own profit; not dat I may cast a snare upon u, but 4 dat which is comely, N dat y’all may attend upon tha Lord without distraction.
But if any man think dat he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass tha flower of her age, N need so require, let him do what he will, he sins not: let ’em marry.
Nevertheless he dat stands stedfast in his heart, havin no necessity, but has power over his own will, N has so decreed in his heart dat he will keep his virgin, does well.
So then he dat gives her in marriage does well; but he dat gives her not in marriage does better.
Tha wife is bound by tha law as long as her husband lives; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty 2 be married 2 whom she will; only in tha Lord.
But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: N I think also dat I have tha Spirit of God.

8.text: Now as touching things offered 2 idols, we know dat we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
N if any man think dat he knows any thing, he knows nothing yet as he ought 2 know.
But if any man love God, tha same is known of him.
As concerning therefore tha eatin of dose things dat r offered in sacrifice 2 idols, we know dat an idol is nothing in tha world, N dat there is none other God but one.
4 though there be dat r called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, N lords many,)
But 2 us there is but one God, tha Father, of whom r all things, N we in him; N one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom r all things, N we by him.
But there is not in every man dat knowledge: 4 some wit conscience of tha idol 2 dis hour eat it as a thing offered 2 an idol; N their conscience bein weak is defiled.
But food commendeth us not 2 God: 4 neither, if we eat, r we tha better; neither, if we eat not, r we tha worse.
But pay attention lest by any means dis liberty of urz become a stumblingblock 2 ’em dat r weak.
4 if any man see u which have knowledge sit at food in tha idol’s temple, shall not tha conscience of him which is weak be emboldened 2 eat dose things which r offered 2 idols;
N through ur knowledge shall tha weak brother perish, 4 whom Christ died?
But when y’all sin so against tha brothers, N wound their weak conscience, y’all sin against Christ.
So, if food make my brother 2 offend, I will eat no flesh while tha world stands, lest I make my brother 2 offend.

9.text: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? r not y’all my work in tha Lord?
If I don’t be an apostle 2 others, yet doubtless I am 2 u: 4 tha seal of mine apostleship r y’all in tha Lord.
Mine answer 2 ’em dat do examine me is dis,
Have we not power 2 eat N 2 drink?
Have we not power 2 lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, N as tha brothers of tha Lord, N Cephas?
Or I only N Barnabas, have not we power 2 forbear workin?
Who goes a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, N eats not of tha fruit of it? or who feeds a flock, N eats not of tha milk of tha flock?
Say I dese things as a man? or says not tha law tha same also?
4 it is written in tha law of Moses, u will not muzzle tha mouth of tha ox dat treads out tha corn. does God take care 4 oxen?
Or says he it altogether 4 our sakes? 4 our sakes, no doubt, dis is written: dat he dat ploweth should plow in hope; N dat he dat thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.
If we have sown 2 u spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap ur carnal things?
If others be partakers of dis power over u, r not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used dis power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder tha gospel of Christ.
Do y’all not know dat dey which minister about holy things live of tha things of tha temple? N dey which wait at tha altar r partakers wit tha altar?
Even so has tha Lord ordained dat dey which preach tha gospel should live of tha gospel.
But I have used none of dese things: neither have I written dese things, dat it should be so done 2 me: 4 it were better 4 me 2 die, than dat any man should make my glorying void.
4 though I preach tha gospel, I have nothing 2 glory of: 4 necessity is laid upon me; yeah, woe is 2 me, if I preach not tha gospel!
4 if I do dis thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of tha gospel is committed 2 me.
What is my reward then? for real dat, when I preach tha gospel, I may make tha gospel of Christ without charge, dat I abuse not my power in tha gospel.
4 though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant 2 all, dat I might gain tha more.
N 2 tha Jews I became as a Jew, dat I might gain tha Jews; 2 ’em dat r under tha law, as under tha law, dat I might gain ’em dat r under tha law;
2 ’em dat r without law, as without law, (bein not without law 2 God, but under tha law 2 Christ,) dat I might gain ’em dat r without law.
2 tha weak became I as weak, dat I might gain tha weak: I am made all things 2 all men, dat I might by all means save some.
N dis I do 4 tha gospel’s sake, dat I might be partaker of it wit u.
Know y’all not dat dey which run in a race run all, but one receives tha prize? So run, dat y’all may obtain.
N every man dat striveth 4 tha mastery is temperate in all things. Now dey do it 2 obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one dat beateth tha air:
But I keep under my body, N bring it in2 subjection: lest dat by any means, when I have preached 2 others, I myself should be a castaway.

10.text: Moreover, brothers, I would not dat y’all should be ignorant, how dat all our fathers were under tha cloud, N all passed through tha sea;
N were all baptized 2 Moses in tha cloud N in tha sea;
N did all eat tha same spiritual food;
N did all drink tha same spiritual drink: 4 dey drank of dat spiritual Rock dat followed ’em: N dat Rock was Christ.
But wit many of ’em God was not well pleased: 4 dey were overthrown in tha wilderness.
Now dese things were our examples, 2 tha intent we should not lust after evil things, as dey also lusted.
Neither be y’all idolaters, as were some of ’em; as it is written, tha people sat down 2 eat N drink, N rose up 2 play.
Neither let us commit fornication, as some of ’em committed, N fell in one day three N twenty thousand.
Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of ’em also tempted, N were destroyed of serpents.
Neither grumble y’all, as some of ’em also grumbled, N were destroyed of tha destroyer.
Now all dese things happened 2 ’em 4 ensamples: N dey r written 4 our admonition, upon whom tha ends of tha world r come.
So let him dat thinks he stands pay attention lest he fall.

There has no temptation taken u but such as is common 2 man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer u 2 be tempted above dat y’all r able; but will wit tha temptation also make a way 2 escape, dat y’all may be able 2 bear it.
So, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
I speak as 2 wise men; judge y’all what I say.
Tha cup of blessing which we bless, is it not tha communion of tha blood of Christ? tha bread which we break, is it not tha communion of tha body of Christ?
4 we bein many r one bread, N one body: 4 we r all partakers of dat one bread.
Look Israel after tha flesh: r not dey which eat of tha sacrifices partakers of tha altar?
What say I then? dat tha idol is any thing, or dat which is offered in sacrifice 2 idols is any thing?
But I say, dat tha things which tha Gentiles sacrifice, dey sacrifice 2 devils, N not 2 God: N I would not dat y’all should have fellowship wit devils.
y’all cannot drink tha cup of tha Lord, N tha cup of devils: y’all cannot be partakers of tha Lord’s table, N of tha table of devils.
Do we provoke tha Lord 2 jealousy? r we stronger than he?
All things r lawful 4 me, but all things r not expedient: all things r lawful 4 me, but all things edify not.
Let no man seek his own, but every man another’s wealth.
Whatever is sold in tha shambles, dat eat, asking no question 4 conscience sake:
4 tha earth is tha Lord’s, N tha fulness of it.
If any of ’em dat believe not bid u 2 a feast, N y’all be disposed 2 go; whatever is set before u, eat, asking no question 4 conscience sake.
But if any man say 2 u, dis is offered in sacrifice 2 idols, eat not 4 his sake dat showed it, N 4 conscience sake: 4 tha earth is tha Lord’s, N tha fulness of it:
Conscience, I say, not ur own, but of tha other: 4 why is my liberty judged of another man’s conscience?
4 if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of 4 dat 4 which I give thanks?
Whether therefore y’all eat, or drink, or whatever y’all do, do all 2 tha glory of God.
Give none offence, neither 2 tha Jews, nor 2 tha Gentiles, nor 2 tha church of God:
Even as I please all men in all things, not seekin my own profit, but tha profit of many, dat dey may be saved.

11.text: Be y’all followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
Now I praise u, brothers, dat y’all remember me in all things, N keep tha ordinances, as I delivered ’em 2 u.
But I would have u know, dat tha head of every man is Christ; N tha head of tha woman is tha man; N tha head of Christ is God.
Every man prayin or prophesying, havin his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
But every woman dat prays or prophesies wit her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: 4 dat is even all one as if she were shaven.
4 if tha woman don’t be covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame 4 a woman 2 be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
4 a man indeed ought not 2 cover his head, forasmuch as he is tha image N glory of God: but tha woman is tha glory of tha man.
4 tha man is not of tha woman; but tha woman of tha man.
Neither was tha man created 4 tha woman; but tha woman 4 tha man.
4 dis cause ought tha woman 2 have power on her head because of tha angels.
Nevertheless neither is tha man without tha woman, neither tha woman without tha man, in tha Lord.
4 as tha woman is of tha man, even so is tha man also by tha woman; but all things of God.
Judge in y’all: is it comely dat a woman pray 2 God uncovered?
Does not even nature itself teach u, dat, if a man have long hair, it is a shame 2 him?
But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory 2 her: 4 her hair is given her 4 a covering.
But if any man seem 2 be contentious, we have no such custom, neither tha churches of God.
Now in dis dat I declare 2 u I praise u not, dat y’all come together not 4 tha better, but 4 tha worse.
4 first of all, when y’all come together in tha church, I hear dat there be divisions among u; N I partly believe it.
4 there must be also heresies among u, dat dey which r approved may be made manifest among u.
When y’all come together therefore in2 one place, dis is not 2 eat tha Lord’s supper.
4 in eatin every one takes before other his own supper: N one is hungry, N another is drunken.
What? have y’all not houses 2 eat N 2 drink in? or despise y’all tha church of God, N shame ’em dat have not? What shall I say 2 u? shall I praise u in dis? I praise u not.
4 I have received of tha Lord dat which also I delivered 2 u, dat tha Lord Jesus tha same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
N when he had given thanks, he broke it, N said, Take, eat: dis is my body, which is broken 4 u: dis do in remembrance of me.
After tha same manner also he took tha cup, when he had supped, sayin, dis cup is tha new testament in my blood: dis do y’all, as oft as y’all drink it, in remembrance of me.
4 as often as y’all eat dis bread, N drink dis cup, y’all do show tha Lord’s death till he come.
So whoever shall eat dis bread, N drink dis cup of tha Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of tha body N blood of tha Lord.
But let a man examine himself, N so let him eat of dat bread, N drink of dat cup.
4 he dat eats N drinks unworthily, eats N drinks damnation 2 himself, not discerning tha Lord’s body.
4 dis cause many r weak N sickly among u, N many sleep.
4 if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
But when we r judged, we r chastened of tha Lord, dat we should not be condemned wit tha world.
So, my brothers, when y’all come together 2 eat, tarry one 4 another.
N if any man hunger, let him eat at home; dat y’all come not together 2 condemnation. N tha rest will I set in order when I come.

12.text: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brothers, I would not have u ignorant.
y’all know dat y’all were Gentiles, carried away 2 dese dumb idols, even as y’all were led.
So I give u 2 understand, dat no man speakin by tha Spirit of God calls Jesus accursed: N dat no man can say dat Jesus is tha Lord, but by tha Holy Ghost.
Now there r diversities of gifts, but tha same Spirit.
N there r differences of administrations, but tha same Lord.
N there r diversities of operations, but it is tha same God which works all in all.
But tha manifestation of tha Spirit is given 2 every man 2 profit withal.
4 2 one is given by tha Spirit tha word of wisdom; 2 another tha word of knowledge by tha same Spirit;
2 another faith by tha same Spirit; 2 another tha gifts of healin by tha same Spirit;
2 another tha workin of miracles; 2 another prophecy; 2 another discerning of spirits; 2 another divers kinds of tongues; 2 another tha interpretation of tongues:
But all dese works dat one N tha selfsame Spirit, dividing 2 every man severally as he will.
4 as tha body is one, N has many members, N all tha members of dat one body, bein many, r one body: so also is Christ.
4 by one Spirit r we all baptized in2 one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; N have been all made 2 drink in2 one Spirit.
4 tha body is not one member, but many.
If tha foot shall say, Because I am not tha hand, I am not of tha body; is it therefore not of tha body?
N if tha ear shall say, Because I am not tha eye, I am not of tha body; is it therefore not of tha body?
If tha whole body were an eye, where were tha hearin? If tha whole were hearin, where were tha smelling?
But now has God set tha members every one of ’em in tha body, as it has pleased him.
N if dey were all one member, where were tha body?
But now r dey many members, yet but one body.
N tha eye cannot say 2 tha hand, I have no need of u: nor again tha head 2 tha feet, I have no need of u.
No, much more dose members of tha body, which seem 2 be more feeble, r necessary:
N dose members of tha body, which we think 2 be less honourable, upon dese we bestow more abundant honour; N our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
4 our comely parts have no need: but God has tempered tha body together, havin given more abundant honour 2 dat part which lacked:
Dat there should be no schism in tha body; but dat tha members should have tha same care one 4 another.
N whether one member suffer, all tha members suffer wit it; or one member be honoured, all tha members rejoice wit it.
Now y’all r tha body of Christ, N members in particular.
N God has set some in tha church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after dat miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
R all apostles? r all prophets? r all teachers? r all workers of miracles?
Have all tha gifts of healin? do all speak wit tongues? do all interpret?
But covet earnestly tha best gifts: N yet show I 2 u a more excellent way.

13.text: Though I speak wit tha tongues of men N of angels, N have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
N though I have tha gift of prophecy, N understand all mysteries, N all knowledge; N though I have all faith, so dat I could remove mountains, N have not charity, I am nothing.
N though I bestow all my goods 2 feed tha poor, N though I give my body 2 be burned, N have not charity, it profits me nothing.
Charity suffereth long, N is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
Does not behave itself unseemly, seeks not her own, is not easily provoked, thinks no evil;
Rejoices not in iniquity, but rejoices in tha truth;
Bears all things, believes all things, hopeth all things, endures all things.
Charity never fails: but whether there be prophecies, dey shall fail; whether there be tongues, dey shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
4 we know in part, N we prophesy in part.
But when dat which is perfect is come, then dat which is in part shall be done away.
When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
4 now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face 2 face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
N now abides faith, hope, charity, dese three; but tha greatest of dese is charity.

14.text: Follow after charity, N desire spiritual gifts, but rather dat y’all may prophesy.
4 he dat speaks in an unknown tongue speaks not 2 men, but 2 God: 4 no man understands him; but in tha spirit he speaks mysteries.
But he dat prophesies speaks 2 men 2 edification, N exhortation, N comfort.
He dat speaks in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he dat prophesies edifieth tha church.
I would dat y’all all spoke wit tongues, but rather dat y’all prophesied: 4 greater is he dat prophesies than he dat speaks wit tongues, except he interpret, dat tha church may receive edifying.
Now, brothers, if I come 2 u speakin wit tongues, what shall I profit u, except I shall speak 2 u either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
N even things without life givin sound, whether pipe or harp, except dey give a distinction in tha sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
4 if tha trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself 2 tha battle?
So likewise y’all, except y’all utter by tha tongue words easy 2 be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? 4 y’all shall speak in2 tha air.
There r, it may be, so many kinds of voices in tha world, N none of ’em is without signification.
Therefore if I know not tha meaning of tha voice, I shall be 2 him dat speaks a barbarian, N he dat speaks shall be a barbarian 2 me.
Even so y’all, forasmuch as y’all r zealous of spiritual gifts, seek dat y’all may excel 2 tha edifying of tha church.
So let him dat speaks in an unknown tongue pray dat he may interpret.
4 if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
What is it then? I will pray wit tha spirit, N I will pray wit tha understanding also: I will sing wit tha spirit, N I will sing wit tha understanding also.
Else when u will bless wit tha spirit, how shall he dat occupieth tha room of tha unlearned say Amen at ur givin of thanks, seein he understands not what u sayest?
4 u for real give thanks well, but tha other is not edified.
I thank my God, I speak wit tongues more than y’all all:
Yet in tha church I had rather speak five words wit my understanding, dat by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
Brothers, don’t be children in understanding: but in malice be y’all children, but in understanding be men.
In tha law it is written, wit men of other tongues N other lips will I speak 2 dis people; N yet 4 all dat will dey not hear me, says tha Lord.
So tongues r 4 a sign, not 2 ’em dat believe, but 2 ’em dat believe not: but prophesying serves not 4 ’em dat believe not, but 4 ’em which believe.
If therefore tha whole church be come together in2 one place, N all speak wit tongues, N there come in dose dat r unlearned, or unbelievers, will dey not say dat y’all r mad?
But if all prophesy, N there come in one dat believes not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
N like dis r tha secrets of his heart made manifest; N so fallin down on his face he will worship God, N report dat God is in u of a truth.
How is it then, brothers? when y’all come together, every one of u has a psalm, has a doctrine, has a tongue, has a revelation, has an interpretation. Let all things be done 2 edifying.
If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at tha most by three, N dat by course; N let one interpret.
But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in tha church; N let him speak 2 himself, N 2 God.
Let tha prophets speak two or three, N let tha other judge.
If any thing be revealed 2 another dat sits by, let tha first hold his peace.
4 y’all may all prophesy one by one, dat all may learn, N all may be comforted.
N tha spirits of tha prophets r subject 2 tha prophets.
4 God is not tha author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of tha saints.
Let ur women keep silence in tha churches: 4 it is not permitted 2 ’em 2 speak; but dey r commanded 2 be under obedience, as also says tha law.
N if dey will learn any thing, let ’em ask their husbands at home: 4 it is a shame 4 women 2 speak in tha church.
What? came tha word of God out from u? or came it 2 u only?
If any man think himself 2 be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge dat tha things dat I write 2 u r tha commandments of tha Lord.
But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
So, brothers, covet 2 prophesy, N forbid not 2 speak wit tongues.
Let all things be done decently N in order.

15.text: Moreover, brothers, I declare 2 u tha gospel which I preached 2 u, which also y’all have received, N in which y’all stand;
By which also y’all r saved, if y’all keep in memory what I preached 2 u, unless y’all have believed in vain.
4 I delivered 2 u first of all dat which I also received, how dat Christ died 4 our sins according 2 tha scriptures;
N dat he was buried, N dat he rose again tha third day according 2 tha scriptures:
N dat he was seen of Cephas, then of tha twelve:
After dat, he was seen of above five hundred brothers at once; of whom tha greater part remain 2 dis present, but some r fallen asleep.
After dat, he was seen of James; then of all tha apostles.
N last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
4 I am tha least of tha apostles, dat am not meet 2 be called an apostle, because I persecuted tha church of God.
But by tha grace of God I am what I am: N his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than dey all: yet not I, but tha grace of God which was wit me.
Therefore whether it were I or dey, so we preach, N so y’all believed.
Now if Christ be preached dat he rose from tha dead, how say some among u dat there is no resurrection of tha dead?
But if there be no resurrection of tha dead, then is Christ not risen:
N if Christ don’t be risen, then is our preachin vain, N ur faith is also vain.
Yeah, N we r found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God dat he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be dat tha dead rise not.
4 if tha dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
N if Christ don’t be raised, ur faith is vain; y’all r yet in ur sins.
Then dey also which r fallen asleep in Christ r perished.
If in dis life only we have hope in Christ, we r of all men most miserable.
But now is Christ risen from tha dead, N become tha firstfruits of ’em dat slept.
4 since by man came death, by man came also tha resurrection of tha dead.
4 as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
But every man in his own order: Christ tha firstfruits; afterward dey dat r Christ’s at his comin.
Then comes tha end, when he shall have delivered up tha kingdom 2 God, even tha Father; when he shall have put down all rule N all authority N power.
4 he must reign, till he has put all opps under his feet.
Tha last opp dat shall be destroyed is death.
4 he has put all things under his feet. But when he says all things r put under him, it is manifest dat he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
N when all things shall be subdued 2 him, then shall tha Son also himself be subject 2 him dat put all things under him, dat God may be all in all.
Else what shall dey do which r baptized 4 tha dead, if tha dead rise not at all? why r dey then baptized 4 tha dead?
N why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
I protest by ur rejoicin which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
If after tha manner of men I have fought wit beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if tha dead rise not? let us eat N drink; 4 2 morrow we die.
Don’t be deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
Awake 2 righteousness, N sin not; 4 some have not tha knowledge of God: I speak dis 2 ur shame.
But some man will say, How r tha dead raised up? N wit what body do dey come?
u fool, dat which u sow is not quickened, except it die:
N dat which u sow, u sow not dat body dat shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
But God gives it a body as it has pleased him, N 2 every seed his own body.
All flesh is not tha same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, N another of birds.
There r also celestial bodies, N bodies terrestrial: but tha glory of tha celestial is one, N tha glory of tha terrestrial is another.
There is one glory of tha sun, N another glory of tha moon, N another glory of tha stars: 4 one star differeth from another star in glory.
So also is tha resurrection of tha dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, N there is a spiritual body.
N so it is written, tha first man Adam was made a livin soul; tha last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
But dat was not first which is spiritual, but dat which is natural; N afterward dat which is spiritual.
Tha first man is of tha earth, earthy: tha second man is tha Lord from heaven.
As is tha earthy, such r dey also dat r earthy: N as is tha heavenly, such r dey also dat r heavenly.
N as we have borne tha image of tha earthy, we shall also bear tha image of tha heavenly.
Now dis I say, brothers, dat flesh N blood cannot inherit tha kingdom of God; neither does corruption inherit incorruption.
Look, I show u a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
In a moment, in tha twinkling of an eye, at tha last trump: 4 tha trumpet shall sound, N tha dead shall be raised incorruptible, N we shall be changed.
4 dis corruptible must put on incorruption, N dis mortal must put on immortality.
So when dis corruptible shall have put on incorruption, N dis mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought 2 pass tha sayin dat is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
O death, where is ur sting? O grave, where is ur victory?
Tha sting of death is sin; N tha strength of sin is tha law.
But thanks be 2 God, which gives us tha victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Therefore, my beloved brothers, be y’all stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in tha work of tha Lord, forasmuch as y’all know dat ur labour is not in vain in tha Lord.

16.text: Now concerning tha collection 4 tha saints, as I have given order 2 tha churches of Galatia, even so do y’all.
Upon tha first day of tha week let every one of u lay by him in store, as God has prospered him, dat there be no gatherings when I come.
N when I come, whoever y’all shall approve by ur letters, ’em will I send 2 bring ur liberality 2 Jerusalem.
N if it be meet dat I go also, dey shall go wit me.
Now I will come 2 u, when I shall pass through Macedonia: 4 I do pass through Macedonia.
N it may be dat I will abide, yeah, N winter wit u, dat y’all may bring me on my journey wherever I go.
4 I will not see u now by tha way; but I trust 2 tarry a while wit u, if tha Lord permit.
But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
4 a great door N effectual is opened 2 me, N there r many adversaries.
Now if Timotheus come, see dat he may be wit u without fear: 4 he works tha work of tha Lord, as I also do.
Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, dat he may come 2 me: 4 I look 4 him wit tha brothers.
As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him 2 come 2 u wit tha brothers: but his will was not at all 2 come at dis time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
Watch y’all, stand fast in tha faith, quit u like men, be strong.
Let all ur things be done wit charity.
I beg u, brothers, (y’all know tha house of Stephanas, dat it is tha firstfruits of Achaia, N dat dey have addicted themselves 2 tha ministry of tha saints,)
Dat y’all submit y’all 2 such, N 2 every one dat helpeth wit us, N laboureth.
I am glad of tha comin of Stephanas N Fortunatus N Achaicus: 4 dat which was lacking on ur part dey have supplied.
4 dey have refreshed my spirit N urz: therefore acknowledge y’all ’em dat r such.
Tha churches of Asia greet u. Aquila N Priscilla greet u much in tha Lord, wit tha church dat is in their house.
All tha brothers greet u. Greet y’all one another wit an holy kiss.
Tha greeting of me Paul wit my own hand.
If any man love not tha Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
Tha grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be wit u.
My love be wit u all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
